title: Complete tenant and platform secret slots before migration 058

phases.objective: Ensure the canonical baseline provides tenant and platform secret slot tables before migration 058 changes storage_backend and inserts sanitized pending-secret metadata.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: The exact local Git checkout applies schema.sql and the migration chain ordered by numeric prefix with filename tie-breaker in disposable MariaDB.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Migrations 057 and 058 can reconcile secret references, create credential bindings, alter secret slot storage backends, and insert only pending metadata without unknown-table failures or secret payloads.
steps: The canonical baseline declares tenant_secrets and platform_secrets with storage, reference, hash, ciphertext, metadata, lifecycle, and audit columns.
Migration 057 remains the canonical owner of credential_bindings and extends secret_references before its inserts.
Migration 058 can alter both secret slot tables and write only deterministic pending-secret metadata.
The manifest requires all secret slot and bridge tables in the runtime support contract and validates both baseline column contracts.
The generator emits both secret baseline contracts in plan evidence before disposable MariaDB starts.
No plaintext secret, provider access, Production mutation, or data copy is introduced.
assertions: schema.sql contains tenant_secrets and platform_secrets definitions.
The runtime support contract includes tenant_secrets, platform_secrets, secret_references, and credential_bindings.
The generator fails closed when either secret slot table or a required baseline column is missing.
The regression suite covers migration 057/058 ordering and secret-free schema safety.
Production/provider mutation and plaintext secret inclusion remain forbidden.
